description: This file defines functions to create various Flex UI components such as receipt cards, event cards, and agenda cards, primarily for a scheduling or calendar interface. It includes functions for building headers, footers, and detailed card layouts with styling and layout logic.

methods.name: buildTitleSubtitleHeader
methods.description: Builds header components with title and optional subtitle.

methods.name: buildCardHeaderSections
methods.description: Creates header sections with padding and separator.

methods.name: createMegaBubbleWithFooter
methods.description: Creates a large 'mega' size FlexBubble with optional footer attachment.

methods.name: createReceiptCard
methods.description: Generates a styled receipt/summary card with items, total, and optional footer.

methods.name: createEventCard
methods.description: Creates a calendar event card with date, title, location, description, and optional action.

methods.name: createAgendaCard
methods.description: Builds an agenda view with a list of events, highlighting current or active events.
